## Welcome!

Hi! I’m Ennea @ Kyal Sin Lin Lei, a graduate student at Baruch College studying AI and Business Analytics with a concentration in Data Analytics.

I genuinely enjoy working with complex data, especially when there is a puzzle to solve, a pattern to uncover, or a messy question that needs to be turned into something clear and useful. I’m especially interested in the intersection of analytics, research, business, and communication, and I love seeing how data can help explain real-world decisions.

Outside of data, I’m a big foodie and a devoted movie and TV person. Some of my favorites include *Dead Poets Society*, *The Breakfast Club*, *Peaky Blinders*, *Game of Thrones*, and *American Psycho*. My current music rotation is a slightly chaotic mix of Air Supply, The Black Eyed Peas, and Suki Waterhouse.

This website is my little data corner for STA 9750, a place to solve puzzles, experiment with ideas, and share the projects I build along the way.

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

if(!require("leaflet")){
    options(repos=c(CRAN="https://cloud.r-project.org"))
    install.packages("leaflet")
    stopifnot(require("leaflet"))
}

baruch_longitude <- -73.98333
baruch_latitude  <- +40.74028

leaflet() |>
  addTiles() |>
  setView(baruch_longitude, baruch_latitude, zoom=17) |>
  addPopups(baruch_longitude, baruch_latitude, 
            "I am a Master's student at <b>Baruch College</b>!")
```
